vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that has the same sound or spelling as another word but a different meaning
vocabulary.meaning_ar: كلمة متجانسة (نفس اللفظ أو الكتابة بمعنى مختلف)

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that sound the same but have different spelling and meaning (bare/bear)
vocabulary.meaning_ar: كلمات متشابهة النطق مختلفة الكتابة والمعنى

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that are written the same but have different meanings (bear the animal / bear = support)
with no covering; empty; open to view
vocabulary.example: The cupboards were bare; there was no food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to support the weight of something; to accept something difficult
vocabulary.note_en: Bear with me = be patient with me.
vocabulary.example: The table can't bear the weight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big wild animal with thick fur
vocabulary.example: We saw a bear in the forest.
The company is hiring new workers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: more high (comparative of high); more expensive (price)
vocabulary.note_en: For people's height use taller, not higher.
vocabulary.example: This price is higher than that one.

vocabulary.meaning_en: complete; all of something; not damaged
an empty space or opening in something; (informal) a very bad place
vocabulary.example: There's a hole in my shirt.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put words on paper or a screen
(noun) something you are allowed by law; (adjective) correct
vocabulary.example: Everyone has the right to vote. / You are right.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have information in your mind
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف k صامت، تُنطق مثل no
vocabulary.note_en: The k is silent; it sounds like "no".

fine_lines.title: homophone vs homograph
fine_lines.explanation_ar: homophone: نفس الصوت، كتابة مختلفة، معنى مختلف (bare/bear). homograph: نفس الكتابة، معنى مختلف (bear الحيوان / bear يتحمل).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Homophone: same sound, different spelling and meaning (bare/bear). Homograph: same spelling, different meaning (bear the animal / bear = support).

examples.sentence: I saw a bear. / I can't bear the noise.

fine_lines.title: bare vs bear
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bare صفة = عارٍ أو فارغ. bear فعل = يتحمّل، واسم = دُب. نقول bear with me (اصبر عليّ).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Bare (adjective) = uncovered or empty. Bear (verb) = support; (noun) = the animal. We say bear with me.

examples.sentence: Please bear with me for a minute.

fine_lines.title: whole vs hole
fine_lines.explanation_ar: whole = كامل. hole = ثقب أو مكان سيئ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Whole = complete. Hole = an opening, or a bad place.

examples.sentence: There's a hole in my sock.

fine_lines.title: write vs right; know vs no; hire vs higher
fine_lines.explanation_ar: write يكتب / right صحيح أو حق. know يعرف / no لا. hire يوظّف / higher أعلى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Write = put words down / right = correct or a legal freedom. Know = have information / no = negative. Hire = give a job / higher = more high.

examples.sentence: You will know how to read.

expressions.example: Bear with me while I find your file.

expressions.meaning_en: completely open for everyone to see
expressions.example: In the interview, his life was laid bare.
You are right. The shop is closed today.
All adults have the right to vote.

grammar.title: Homonym, homophone, homograph
grammar.explanation_ar: homonym المصطلح العام: كلمات متشابهة باسم واحد. homophone: نفس النطق وكتابة مختلفة. homograph: نفس الكتابة ومعنى مختلف. في الكلام لا تظهر المشكلة، لكن في الكتابة يجب اختيار الكلمة الصحيحة.
grammar.explanation_en: Homonym is the general term: words with the same name. Homophone: same sound, different spelling. Homograph: same spelling, different meaning. In speech there's no problem, but in writing you must choose the correct word.
examples: Those four things are for you. (four/for)
Go to the store to buy milk, and say bye to John. (buy/bye)

grammar.title: Use context and part of speech
grammar.explanation_ar: لاختيار الكلمة الصحيحة اسأل: هل أحتاج فعلًا أم اسمًا أم صفة؟ مثال: bear (فعل) with me، watch the whole (صفة) video، write (فعل) a letter.
grammar.explanation_en: To choose the right word, ask: do I need a verb, a noun or an adjective? Example: bear (verb) with me, watch the whole (adjective) video, write (verb) a letter.
examples: I want you to bear with me.
Go on to the higher lessons.
When you complete the whole video, you will know how to read and write.
